newsitem.title: UK: LASMO makes oil production stock payment.
newsitem.headline: LASMO makes oil production stock payment.

text.p: Oil and gas exploration and production company LASMO Plc said on Tuesday it would make an Oil Production Stock (OPS) payment of 4.9 pence per unit for the six months to June 30, 1996.
The payment will be made on October 31 to holders on the register on October 15, LASMO said in a statement.
Payment for the six months to December 31, 1995 was made at the rate of 3.39 pence per unit, it added.

OPS units were issued in 1976 to help fund the LASMO share of the Ninian field development costs. This began production in December 1978 and holders have been receiving payments every six months since.
